Silver labels: 2 independent LLM annotators (Claude Opus, Claude Sonnet), 600 (JD, CV) pairs, graded 0–3. Agreement: exact 84.3%, quadratic-weighted κ = 0.919. Gold = mean of the two. These are **silver** labels until human annotators check them (docs/EVAL.md).
